status: runner implemented (scripts/benchmarks/joint_api_campaign.py + joint_lab.py); pilot required before the official run
scope: Placement and Glance loaded at the same time through the public Apache routes, in the 2x2 design (Python/Go each). Each window yields Placement metrics with Glance load and Glance metrics with Placement load, measured with the instruments of the individual campaigns

pairs.why: what Nova does to each service when it boots: candidates/claim/provider reads and show/download/list
writes in Placement (claim/read/release) while Glance streams image bytes
the heaviest Placement query while Glance answers metadata reads

concurrency_note: the same C applies to both generators in a window
order: per (pair, concurrency, repetition) block, the four variants in a seeded random order
load_model: closed-loop for both generators, on the host; both started together, each with its own barrier
routes: both services through Apache (/placement, /image) as Nova reaches them; Glance with noop notifications in both implementations as in glance-v7

per_service: p50/p95/p99 per run and per operation
CPU s per correct request (service cgroup)

acceptance: All 72 windows valid: both generators valid (status, bodies, bytes and hashes), measurement windows overlapping at least 90 %, clock drift < 100 ms, seeds removed after each window, original services, routes and catalogs restored, owned runtimes and identities retired
comparability: Placement windows use placement-compact-v2 timing and scenarios (warm-up 10 s, 30 s, C=1/16, 3 repetitions); Glance windows use glance-v7 timing and scenarios. Individual-campaign results are the 'alone' reference; this campaign is the 'together' condition
statistics: Three paired repetitions per cell; median and observed range, Go/Python ratios paired by repetition against python-python; no significance claims
